title: Skin Care for Delhi Weather: A Season-by-Season Routine for Heat, Smog and Cold
ex: Dry summer heat, a humid monsoon, smog from October and cold, foggy winters with heaters: how to adjust one simple routine for Delhi weather.
rt: Skin Care for Delhi Weather: Seasonal Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Delhi weather: dry summer heat, monsoon, smog season, cold winters, heaters and hard water, with a simple routine for each season in Delhi NCR.
quick: Delhi swings between dry summer heat, a humid monsoon and cold, smoggy winters, so keep the same few products but change texture and amount: light moisturiser and strong sunscreen in summer, gentle cleansing in the monsoon, and a careful night cleanse plus richer cream from November to January.
facts: Delhi smog spells usually come between October and January
Hazy and foggy days still let UV through
Hard water and hot baths leave skin tighter
